sources.description: This was a lot better, certainly light years healthier in comparison to how dismal the Eagles’ first dress rehearsal looked last week in Baltimore. This time, the Eagles’s backups resembled somewhat of an NFL team, despite a 24-21 loss to the defending AFC champion New England Patriots on Saturday night at Gillette Stadium. The execution […]
